name: Enraged Spirits
summary: Enraged Spirits is an Alliance quest given by Kaela Shadowspear in the Stonetalon Mountains. After the Venture Company laid waste to the Charred Vale with fire and heavy machinery, furious fire elementals broke free and overran the blighted basin. Alliance champions are asked to quell these roaming spirits of flame and stone so the wounded land might one day heal under Elune's grace.

sections.title: A Scorched Tragedy
sections.body: The Charred Vale was once a lush haven within Stonetalon, but the reckless greed of the Venture Company transformed it into an ashen wasteland. In their drive to log and strip the land of resources, the goblins deployed incendiary devices and heavy machinery that set the entire canopy ablaze. Their destructive meddling did not merely destroy trees; it shattered the fragile elemental balance beneath the earth.

sections.title: Unleashed Fury
sections.body: The venture did not go as planned for the goblins. The conflagration and deep excavation stirred ancient, dormant spirits of fire, stone, and fury from the depths. These enraged elementals swiftly turned on the trespassers, driving the Venture Company back and claiming the smoldering crater as their own. Kaela Shadowspear laments that until these chaotic elementals are culled, nature can never begin to recover.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Enraged Spirits?
faq.answer: Kaela Shadowspear, a night elf sentinel stationed in the Stonetalon Mountains, gives this quest to Alliance adventurers seeking to aid the land.

faq.q: Why are the fire elementals rampaging in the Charred Vale?
faq.answer: The Venture Company clear-cut and torched the forest using destructive machinery. Their invasive industrial methods disrupted the earth and unleashed dormant spirits of flame, stone, and rage that quickly overran the area.

faq.q: What happened to the Venture Company in the Charred Vale?
aliases: did goblins die in charred vale
faq.answer: The goblins ignited the forest, but their carelessness unleashed elementals far more dangerous than anticipated. The furious fiery beings overwhelmed their operations, leaving behind ruined camps and blazing wreckage.

Smoldering Embers are the burning remnants collected from destroyed fire elementals in the Charred Vale, brought back to Kaela Shadowspear as physical proof that their chaotic numbers have been culled.

faq.q: Can the Charred Vale ever recover?
faq.answer: Kaela Shadowspear believes the land has no chance of feeling Elune's blessing or recovering while hostile elementals wander the ashes. Removing these rampaging spirits is the first step toward any eventual healing.

faq.q: Where is the Charred Vale located?
faq.answer: The Charred Vale lies in the southwestern region of the Stonetalon Mountains, marked by blackened earth, burned timber, and roaming elemental spirits.

angles.text: For night elves, the devastation of the Charred Vale is a heartbreaking wound inflicted on Kalimdor's sacred wildlands by unchecked industrial avarice.
Druids view the rampaging fire elementals as a catastrophic disruption of nature's equilibrium, requiring active intervention before life can return to the soil.
Shaman understand that the elementals' wrath is a direct, agonizing reaction to the reckless exploitation of the earth by mortal miners and loggers.
The Alliance works through night elf sentinels in Stonetalon to contain the chaos caused by goblin cartels and restore safety to the mountain passes.
